turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

SIGNING IN, YOU AGREE TO OUR PRIVACY POLICY AND TERMS OF SERVICE.

HOW LONG DOES IT NORMALLY TAKE TO SHIP AND SEND A TRACKING NUMBER?
We normally process orders within 2–3 BUSINESS DAYS. Once your order ships, we email a shipping confirmation with a tracking link. Check your spam or junk folder too; after the email arrives, carrier updates can take 24–48 HOURS to appear.
I can’t see your order status until you sign in. Once you do, I can check whether it has shipped.

Tracking can take 24–48 HOURS AFTER YOU RECEIVE THE SHIPPING CONFIRMATION to update on the carrier’s site. If it still hasn’t updated after that, or your package hasn’t arrived within the estimated delivery window, let us know so we can help look into it.
